'''Hobin Carsamba''' was an [[alien]] who worked as a [[scavenger]] on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] in [[34 ABY]]. Carsamba once joined a queue to [[Merchant|trade]] with the [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]] in [[Niima Outpost]] while the scavenger [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] dealt with Plutt at the front of the line. The next [[Standard day|day]], Carsamba was still in Niima when it was [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] by the [[First Order military|forces]] of the [[First Order]].

==Biography==
Hobin Carsamba<ref name="LEGO TFA">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> was an [[alien]]<ref name="Art" /> [[scavenger]] who made a living on the [[desert]] [[planet]] of [[Jakku]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Carsamba was present in [[Niima Outpost]], a Jakku [[Merchant|trading]] settlement run by the<ref name="TFA" /> [[Crolute]]<ref name="TL">{{StoryCite|story=True Love|book=Tales from a Galaxy Far, Far Away: Aliens: Volume I}}</ref> [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]].<ref name="TFA" />

[[File:Hobin_Carsamba_Niima.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Hobin Carsamba passed the scavenger Rey in Niima Outpost.]]
Having salvaged junk to trade, Carsamba once joined the line of customers waiting to deal with Plutt at his<ref name="TFA" /> [[Concession Stand]]<ref name="TL" /> while the scavenger [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] was dealing with Plutt at the front of the line. Carsamba fell into position between<ref name="TFA" /> the pet seller and storyteller [[Bobbajo]]<ref name="ACGAS">{{StoryCite|story=All Creatures Great and Small|book=Tales from a Galaxy Far, Far Away: Aliens: Volume I}}</ref> and another [[humanoid]] scavenger at the end of the line.<ref name="TFA" />

Carsamba was in Niima again the next [[Standard day|day]] and, while heading away from Plutt's stand, passed Rey as she arrived with the [[Resistance]] [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] on her [[Rey's speeder|speeder]]. Carsamba was still present later that day when Niima was [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] by the [[First Order military|forces]] of the [[First Order]] in their search for BB-8. Rey, BB-8, and the First Order [[Desertion|deserter]] [[Finn]] fled past Carsamba through a number of Niima's marquees while trying to escape from pursuing [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Equipment==
While in Niima, Carsamba wore [[Color|brown]] [[clothing]] and a dark [[Armor|helmet]]. The scavenger also carried a large, yellow back-mounted cylinder, as well as a smaller, yellow chest-mounted box.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So we put a Wat Tambor-type sound. Because it looks like a guy that's, like, a prototype or [the] same race as Wat Tambor [who's] in the background there. And I put a little [imitates Wat Tambor's robotic sound] to kind of make it sound like [him].|Matthew Wood speaks about Hobin Carsamba|<ref name="MattWood">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dailydot.com/parsec/star-wars-force-awakens-sound-design-matthew-wood-interview|text='Star Wars: The Force Awakens' sound designer explains how he helped rework a major scene|author=Geller, Eric|date=2020-02-29|archivedate=20210113150040}}</ref>}}
[[File:Hobin_unmasked.png|thumb|right|200px|Scott Baldwin on set as Hobin Carsamba]]
Hobin Carsamba first appeared in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']],<ref name="TFA" /> where he was portrayed by [[Scott Baldwin]].<ref name="Dressing the Galaxy">{{Film|VII}} 3D Collector's Edition: "Dressing the Galaxy" featurette</ref> Concept art of Carsamba was drawn by costume conceptual artist [[Glyn Dillon]] during pre-production of ''The Force Awakens'' in [[October]] [[2013]]. This artwork titled the character "Outpost Alien C039."<ref name="Art" /> As sound designer [[Matthew Wood]] believed Carsamba looked similar to the<ref name="MattWood" /> [[Skakoan]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> character [[Wat Tambor]], whom he had voiced in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', he added a sound effect imitating Tambor's [[Skakoverbal|robotic voice]] to the scene in the film in which Carsamba is standing in the Concession Stand.<ref name="MattWood" />

The character was not named in the film but was identified in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''.<ref name="LEGO TFA" /> Despite the game being [[Canon|non-canon]], [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] confirmed that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters, including Carsamba, were considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}} — [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] confirmed that the character names introduced in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' are considered [[canon]], despite the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] itself being non-canon.</ref>
